info.title: Get Shop Performance
info.description: Returns performance metrics at shop/seller level.

get.description: Returns performance metrics at shop/seller level.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: start_date_ge
parameters.description:
Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive)

parameters.name: end_date_lt
parameters.description:
End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description:
Granularity of the data.
Available values: ALL, 1D
Default value: ALL
* ALL: aggregate
* 1D: daily

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description:
Currency.
Available values: USD, LOCAL
Default value: LOCAL
* USD: US dollars
* LOCAL: local currency where the shop is located

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

start_date.description: Start date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, inclusive.

end_date.description: End date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, exclusive.

amount.description: GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

amount.description: GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

gmv.description: Gross merchandise value: Total amount paid for orders during the selected period, including canceled and refunded orders.

type.description:
GMV breakdown type.
Possible values:
- VIDEO: Video content.
- LIVE: Live stream content.
- PRODUCT_CARD: Product card.

gmv.description: Gross merchandise value: Total amount paid for orders during the selected period, including canceled and refunded orders.

amount.description: GMV amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

percentage.description: The percentage of revenue generated from the corresponding breakdown type.

type.description:
Gross revenue breakdown type by market.
For SEA, MX, and BR markets, possible values are NON_GMV_MAX and GMV_MAX.
For UK and EU markets, possible values are ADS and ORGANIC.
This breakdown is not applicable for US and JP markets.

gross_revenue.description: Gross revenue includes customer payments and platform product subsidies, minus any applicable taxes. Formula: Gross revenue = (Customer payment + Platform product subsidies) − Taxes

items_sold.description: The total number of individual items sold. Example: If a customer buys 3 units of SKU A and 2 units of SKU B, the items sold would be 5.

sku_orders_count.description: A total count of distinct SKUs sold.

orders_count.description: The number of paid orders during the selected period.

avg_customers_count.description: Daily average number of unique users who paid for orders during the selected period.

amount.description: Refunds amount in the corresponding currency.

currency.description: GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP).

refunds.description: The amount of order refunds generated.

avg_page_views.description: Daily average number of page views for all of your product detail pages during the selected period.

avg_visitors.description: Daily average number of unique users who visited your product detail pages during the selected period

avg_conversation_rate.description: The daily average percentage of unique users who paid for orders after viewing product detail pages during the selected period.

traffic.description: Traffic data for the interval, including average page views, average visitors, and average conversion rate.

intervals.description: Interval data for the requested time range. The time range of each interval is determined by the granularity.

performance.description: Overall performance data for the shop.

latest_available_date.description: Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format).
